cases.scenario: An authenticated tenant A user enqueues a task naming tenant B and the stub worker changes B's protected record.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm the authority break only with producer reachability, policy and persisted stub effect.

cases.scenario: A job explicitly authorized at enqueue completes under its documented contract after the UI session ends.
cases.expected_decision: Do not infer a revocation defect from session expiry alone.

cases.scenario: A job ID is enumerable but both status and result enforce the rightful owner.
cases.expected_decision: Do not report cross-tenant job data exposure without a protected disclosure or action.
